failedOnBoth.test: Nodes > TSL > barriers > textureBarrier: a workgroup-mate's storage-texture write is visible after the barrier
failedOnBoth.why: the test's StorageTexture is FloatType with the default RGBAFormat, so rgba32float, accessed read_write -- which core WebGPU allows only on r32float, r32sint and r32uint; rgba32float needs 'texture-formats-tier2', which SwiftShader's adapter does not offer. The bind group layout fails validation ("RGBA32Float does not support storage texture access ReadWrite"), the kernel never runs and the sum reads 0. Not the barrier: unit/texture-barrier-r32float.diff sets RedFormat (r32float) and the test passes (unit/texture-barrier.md, held by tools/ship/threeTextureBarrier-selfcheck.mjs)
